baseline.current_official_baseline: D / Claude pass2 = 93.6 under post-T327 canonical-66 corpus baseline and unchanged T314 reviewed-structural-split evaluator policy
baseline.pre_t327_wider_corpus_baseline: D / Claude pass2 = 93.5 under T314 reviewed-structural-split evaluator policy
baseline.score_interpretation: T327D score movement is corpus-scope correction / baseline reset, not chunking improvement; T314 score movement remains evaluator-policy correction.

cases.why_hard: Long Psalm with praise, covenant memory, lament, and petition; one literary unit has several internal turns.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: A whole-psalm chunk may be too coarse, while unreviewed section splits could hide covenant/lament unity.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium: English strophe and sentence punctuation may steer section boundaries.
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: medium: poetic formatting differs across translations.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review parent whole-psalm unit and child sections for praise, oracle/covenant memory, lament, and petition.
cases.notes: Good long-Psalm follow-up after Ps.119 and Ps.78.

cases.why_hard: Historical recital Psalm compresses narrative episodes into poetic sequence.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may split by token pressure without preserving episode sequence and whole-Psalm unity.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium: poetic sentence boundaries and stanza breaks can alter sectioning.
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: medium: parallels with narrative accounts may not align verse-for-verse.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review historical-episode child sections under a parent whole-Psalm unit.
cases.notes: Candidate for parent/child historical-poetry gold.

cases.why_hard: Long confession Psalm moves through repeated rebellion, mercy, and petition cycles.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Naive splits may flatten repeated cycle structure or over-fragment the Psalm.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium: repeated clauses and poetic formatting affect perceived units.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review cycle-based child chunks and whole-Psalm parent claim.
cases.notes: Pairs naturally with Ps.105 for historical Psalm stress coverage.

cases.why_hard: Refrain-driven litany repeats a line across creation, exodus, wilderness, land, and praise sections.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may split mechanically by repeated refrain rather than preserving liturgical movement.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium: refrain punctuation and line grouping influence boundary choices.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review refrain-aware child sections under one liturgical parent unit.
cases.notes: Tests whether repeated structure is handled as form evidence rather than noise.

cases.why_hard: Acrostic laments combine poem-level unity, stanza structure, and shifting voices/personification.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: A Psalm-specific parent/child rule may not generalize safely to Lamentations without non-target gold.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium: personified city and narrator transitions are punctuation-sensitive.
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: medium: acrostic visibility and stanza headings vary.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: high: narrator, Zion, and communal voices can blur.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review per-chapter poem parents, acrostic child sections, and speaker-change annotations.
cases.notes: Important non-Psalm precedent for acrostic parent/child handling.

cases.why_hard: Acrostic wisdom poem is embedded inside a chapter with adjacent instruction.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may either merge with surrounding prose/wisdom material or split the acrostic too finely.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: medium: acrostic structure is not equally visible in translation.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review poem boundary at Prov.31.10-31 and possible stanza children.
cases.notes: Wisdom-form stress case for parent/child sectioning.

cases.why_hard: Large divine speech block with rhetorical questions, creature sections, and discourse climax.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may split by chapter/token rather than speech sections or rhetorical movement.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: rhetorical question runs and poetic punctuation shape units.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: medium: speaker label at the block start must govern long internal spans.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review divine-speech parent and internal sections by topic/rhetorical movement.
cases.notes: Uses real `sp` speaker-marker risk from the raw inventory.

cases.why_hard: Song embedded in covenant/legal narrative with source-tradition and theological pressure points.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may treat the song as ordinary chapter text or miss parent song unity.
cases.text_critical_risk: high: Deut.32 has important textual-tradition issues, especially around 32.8-9.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: high: divine-council wording and poetic formatting vary.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: medium: Moses/song voice and surrounding narrative frame interact.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review song parent, child stanzas, and text-critical note fields.
cases.notes: Separate whole-song case from the narrower Deut.32.8-9 text-critical case.

cases.why_hard: Servant Song spans a chapter boundary with debated speakers and high theological load.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chapter-boundary splitting could sever the unit; over-merge can hide speaker/stanza turns.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: speaker and subject shifts depend on punctuation and translation choices.
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: high: poetic layout and messianic interpretation cues vary.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review cross-chapter parent unit, child stanzas, and speaker-risk annotations.
cases.notes: High-priority prophetic poetry case.

cases.why_hard: Multi-chapter vision sequence with angelic discourse, historical preview, and resurrection/ending sections.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may split by chapters and miss vision-scene continuity and discourse hierarchy.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: angelic speech and narrative frame shifts depend on punctuation.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review vision parent, scene/speech children, and speaker-boundary notes.
cases.notes: Apocalyptic stress case before Revelation work.

cases.why_hard: Extended apocalyptic cycle with signs, beasts, bowls, Babylon, angelic voices, and hymnic interruptions.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chapter chunks may miss vision-cycle boundaries; fine splits may detach interpretive context.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: voices, hymns, and angelic commands need careful boundaries.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review vision-cycle parent/child structure and speaker/voice annotations.
cases.notes: One of the strongest candidates for future stress-atlas gold.

cases.why_hard: Famously long Greek blessing sentence with layered clauses and theological argument.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: English sentence segmentation may differ from Greek syntax; splitting can fracture the blessing.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: punctuation decisions strongly shape clause units.
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: high: English versions segment the Greek sentence differently.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review parent sentence/blessing unit and child clause groups.
cases.notes: Core long-Greek-sentence test.

cases.why_hard: Longer ending is a major textual variant and has resurrection-scene links to other Gospel traditions.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunking could treat a text-critical appendix as ordinary continuation without variant metadata.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: high: editions/translations differ in inclusion and marking.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review variant-zone handling and non-implementation annotation before any boundary change.
cases.notes: Text-critical risk case, not a chunking target by itself.

cases.why_hard: Pericope adulterae is a major textual variant with dense dialogue and narrative framing.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may split dialogue poorly or fail to preserve variant-zone identity.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: high: editions/translations differ in placement or marking.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: high: Jesus, accusers, narrator, and woman interact rapidly.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review variant-zone parent, dialogue children, and text-critical status.
cases.notes: High-priority text-critical/dialogue stress case.

cases.why_hard: Jeremiah has major MT/LXX differences in order and length, affecting oracle alignment.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: English WEB chunk boundaries may not map cleanly to future LXX/source-language witnesses.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: high: source tradition and ordering mismatch.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Create tradition-aware review packets before aligning prophetic oracle chunks.
cases.notes: Do not implement until source-language/tradition policy is explicit.

cases.why_hard: DSS/Nahash paragraph issue can change how the transition into 1 Sam 11 is contextualized.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: A short transition can be detached from required narrative context or variant framing.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: high: traditions and translations may handle the transition differently.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review transition-context packet and tradition note before any chunk change.
cases.notes: Short context-dependent plus textual-tradition stress case.

cases.why_hard: Compact, heavily debated passage whose interpretation depends on broader biblical and ancient-context links.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Small unit can be over-isolated from flood prologue and divine-council/giants context.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review context packet requirements and hard-exegesis annotations.
cases.notes: Hard exegesis does not authorize theological graph claims.

cases.why_hard: Short but text-critically and theologically loaded divine-council passage.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Can be too small for context yet too important to bury inside a larger undifferentiated song chunk.
cases.text_critical_risk: high: wording differs across textual traditions.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: high: translations diverge on key phrase.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review as text-critical subcase inside Deut.32 song parent.
cases.notes: Keep as stress subcase, not a standalone output-changing target.

cases.why_hard: Short Psalm with divine assembly scene, judgment speech, and debated referents.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Single whole-Psalm chunk is likely appropriate, but speaker/context metadata may be critical later.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: quotation/speaker boundaries shape interpretation.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review whole-Psalm retention plus speaker-boundary notes for future context packets.
cases.notes: Entity/concept implications belong to future lanes, not T316 implementation.

cases.why_hard: Narrative includes rapid dialogue, prophetic dispute, and heavenly council vision.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Dialogue and vision may be split in ways that lose the hearing/vision frame.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: quoted speech boundaries are central.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review narrative parent, dialogue children, and parallel-account notes.
cases.notes: Potential parallel with 2 Chronicles account should be considered later.

cases.why_hard: Dense throne vision with nested visual details, movement, and theological imagery.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may split visual features apart or over-merge a highly structured vision.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: nested descriptions depend on punctuation and clauses.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review vision parent and visual-scene child boundaries.
cases.notes: Vision-description stress case.

cases.why_hard: Extended temple/land vision mixes measurements, ritual/legal material, and visionary sequence.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may make arbitrary chapter splits instead of architectural/ritual/land sections.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: medium: measurement terms and section headings vary.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: medium: guide speech and narrative frame interact.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review multi-chapter parent/child hierarchy and measurement/list handling.
cases.notes: Large-scale parent/child stress case.

cases.why_hard: Night-vision sequence alternates visions, interpreting angel speech, and oracles.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Vision sequence may be broken by chapters or merged past interpreter/vision boundaries.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: interpreter dialogue and vision reports depend on punctuation.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review sequence parent with vision-level child chunks.
cases.notes: Good bridge case between prophets and apocalyptic.

cases.why_hard: Long discourse with prophetic material, parables, judgment scenes, and debated eschatological referents.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Over-splitting loses discourse unity; under-splitting obscures parable/oracle sections.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: discourse transitions and quotation boundaries matter.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: medium: Jesus' extended speech must remain framed.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review discourse parent and child sections by question/oracle/parable/judgment movement.
cases.notes: Core Gospel discourse stress case.

cases.why_hard: Farewell discourse spans narrative action, dialogue, long teaching, and prayer.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may mix narrative frame, dialogue turns, discourse units, and prayer boundaries.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: dialogue and discourse transitions matter.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: high: Jesus, disciples, narrator, and prayer address boundaries matter.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review parent discourse block and child narrative/dialogue/discourse/prayer sections.
cases.notes: High-value discourse/context-packet case.

cases.why_hard: Sustained theological argument with citations, objections, and doxological close.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chapter splits may break argument flow; smaller chunks may lose objection/answer structure.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: rhetorical questions and quotation boundaries shape units.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: medium: Paul, scripture quotations, and imagined interlocutor interact.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review argument parent and child sections by rhetorical movement.
cases.notes: Core Pauline argument stress case.

cases.why_hard: Compact, difficult passage with Christ, spirits in prison, Noah, baptism, and resurrection/exaltation links.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Short unit may need broader argument context while retaining internal clause structure.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: clause attachment shapes interpretation.
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: high: translations differ on syntax and referents.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review context-packet needs and punctuation/syntax risk before chunk changes.
cases.notes: Hard-exegesis short-unit stress case.

cases.why_hard: Dense examples, angel traditions, Michael dispute, and Enoch quotation require careful context separation.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may split examples from argument or merge distinct traditions into one opaque block.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: example chain and quotation boundary matter.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review argument parent, example-chain children, and quotation/tradition annotations.
cases.notes: Future concept/extrabiblical-source interactions must stay separate from chunk implementation.

cases.why_hard: Very long administrative verse with dispatch details, peoples, provinces, and languages.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Verse-atomic assumptions can create oversized or hard-to-read retrieval units.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: list punctuation affects readability and split candidates.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review long-verse/list handling and whether internal list boundaries can be retrieval children.
cases.notes: Canonical long-verse stress case.

cases.why_hard: Genealogy, birth narrative, and fulfillment quotation sit in one chapter.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may merge genealogy with birth narrative or split genealogy without preserving formulaic structure.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review genealogy parent/sections and narrative/quotation separation.
cases.notes: Genealogy plus Gospel narrative transition case.

cases.why_hard: Genealogy follows baptism material and differs structurally from Matthew.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may fail to separate baptism scene, divine voice, and genealogy list.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: medium: divine voice in baptism context precedes genealogy.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review genealogy boundary and parallel-account alignment notes.
cases.notes: Pair with Matt.1 for genealogy stress coverage.

cases.why_hard: Massive genealogical block with tribal, family, and return/community structures.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Token/list pressure may produce arbitrary chunks that do not preserve genealogical hierarchy.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium: list punctuation and headings matter.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review hierarchy-aware list parents and child sections by genealogy block.
cases.notes: Large list/genealogy atlas anchor.

cases.why_hard: Land allotment chapters combine geography, lists, tribal sections, and legal inheritance logic.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may split lists arbitrarily or lose tribal/legal parent-child hierarchy.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review tribal allotment parents and list/geography child chunks.
cases.notes: Administrative list plus legal geography stress case.

cases.why_hard: Ritual procedure has ordered steps, actor changes, sacrificial logic, and theological significance.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may split procedure steps from their legal/ritual frame or over-merge details.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review ritual parent and procedure-step child boundaries.
cases.notes: Legal/ritual stress anchor.

cases.why_hard: Decalogue and covenant-case-law material mix apodictic commands, case laws, and covenant frame.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may not distinguish command lists, case-law clusters, and narrative/covenant frame.
cases.punctuation_risk: medium
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review legal block parents, command/case-law child clusters, and speech-frame notes.
cases.notes: Major legal/covenant parent-child case.

cases.why_hard: Sustained argument about priesthood, covenant, tabernacle, sacrifice, and exhortation.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chapter splits can fragment argument dependencies and OT citation logic.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: argument clauses and quotation boundaries matter.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: medium: scripture quotations and homiletic voice interact.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review argument parent and child sections by priesthood/covenant/sacrifice/exhortation movement.
cases.notes: High-priority epistle argument case.

cases.why_hard: Multi-chapter argument moves through knowledge/love, rights, Israel examples, idolatry, and conscience.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunker may isolate chapters and lose the whole argument's pastoral/theological flow.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: rhetorical questions and example transitions matter.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: medium: Paul, rhetorical interlocutor, and scripture/example material interact.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review argument parent and child sections across the three chapters.
cases.notes: Pairs with Rom.9-11 and Heb.7-10 for argument-section stress coverage.

cases.why_hard: The WEB source contains many words-of-Jesus `\wj` spans, including nested word-token context, but red-letter markup is translation/editorial evidence and not automatic speaker authority.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunking could silently treat every `\wj` span as an authoritative speaker boundary or split trigger, encoding speaker-attribution decisions without review.
cases.text_critical_risk: medium: some `\wj` spans occur near variant or tradition-sensitive passages.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: quotations, nested dialogue, and paragraphing often determine whether `\wj` aligns with a discourse boundary.
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: high: red-letter and quotation conventions vary across editions and translations.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: high: `\wj` is evidence, not authority; speaker attribution cannot be silently encoded by chunking.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Create marker-aware review packets that distinguish `\wj` evidence from approved speaker boundaries before any gold or output change.
cases.notes: Local evidence: RAW_SOURCE_INVENTORY reports 4,580 `\wj` markers; current canonical sidecars include `wj` nesting context. Human review is required before any speaker or boundary behavior changes.

cases.why_hard: Selah and related `\qs` liturgical-rubric spans appear inside poetic lines and may coincide with pauses, stanzas, or performance cues, but they are not automatically approved chunk boundaries.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunking could either ignore useful liturgical evidence or over-split Psalms whenever `\qs` appears, confusing marker preservation with reviewed structure.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: `\qs` often appears mid-psalm near punctuation and line endings.
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: medium: Selah display and rubric handling vary across editions and translations.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: medium: rubrics can interact with quoted speech or shifts in poetic address.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review representative `\qs` Psalms and decide when Selah is boundary evidence, context metadata, or neither.
cases.notes: Local evidence: RAW_SOURCE_INVENTORY reports 148 `\qs` markers and boundary claims show `\qs` in Psalm lines. Human review is required before any gold or output change.

cases.why_hard: John 3 includes dialogue and discourse where translations and editors can differ on where Jesus' speech ends and narrator or reflection begins.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunking could use `\wj` or punctuation to silently decide the disputed speaker boundary, producing retrieval chunks that encode an unreviewed attribution.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: quotation punctuation and paragraphing strongly affect perceived speaker boundaries.
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: high: red-letter and quotation traditions may differ on the discourse boundary.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: high: `\wj` is evidence, not authority; speaker attribution requires human review before gold or output change.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Create a John 3 speaker-boundary review packet before any marker-aware Gospel discourse chunking work.
cases.notes: This case specifically tests the governance rule that chunking must not silently encode speaker-attribution or theological interpretation.

cases.why_hard: The Sermon on the Mount is a long structured Jesus discourse with beatitudes, antitheses, prayer, warnings, and conclusion material, with `\wj` evidence throughout.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: A chunker may over-merge the whole discourse, over-split by headings or red-letter spans, or treat `\wj` as an unreviewed authority for speaker/boundary decisions.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: discourse subunits and quotations depend on punctuation, paragraphs, and poetic formatting.
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: medium: headings, red-letter display, and paragraphing vary across editions.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: high: Jesus discourse framing must be reviewed; `\wj` is evidence, not authority.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review a parent Sermon unit plus child discourse sections before any output-changing Gospel discourse skill work.
cases.notes: Local evidence includes `\wj` in Matthew 5 boundary claims. Speaker attribution cannot be silently encoded by chunking. Human review is required before any gold or output change.

cases.why_hard: The farewell discourse spans narrative action, dialogue, teaching, and prayer; `\wj` spans may help locate speech but cannot settle discourse or prayer boundaries by themselves.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunking could mix narrator, Jesus, disciples, and prayer address boundaries, or treat red-letter spans as sufficient authority for parent/child discourse chunks.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: dialogue and prayer transitions depend on punctuation and paragraphing.
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: medium: red-letter, heading, and paragraph traditions vary.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: high: `\wj` is evidence, not authority; speaker attribution requires human review before gold or output change.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Review parent Farewell Discourse and child narrative/dialogue/discourse/prayer sections with `\wj` treated as evidence only.
cases.notes: Complements the broader `john13_17_farewell_discourse` case with explicit marker-governance risk.

cases.why_hard: The Olivet/apocalyptic discourse material is long, parallel across Synoptic accounts, and interpretively loaded; `\wj` spans identify red-letter evidence but do not decide discourse scope or parallel alignment.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunking may isolate chapters, overfit one Gospel's paragraphing, or silently encode eschatological and speaker-scope decisions.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: quotation boundaries, prophetic units, and parable transitions depend on punctuation and paragraphing.
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: medium: parallel accounts, headings, and red-letter conventions may diverge.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: high: Jesus discourse framing must be reviewed; `\wj` is evidence, not authority.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Create review packets for Matthew 24-25 and Mark 13 before any parallel-aware or apocalyptic-discourse output change.
cases.notes: Complements the existing Matthew 24-25 case by adding Mark 13, parallel alignment, and explicit words-of-Jesus governance. Speaker attribution cannot be silently encoded by chunking. Human review is required before any gold or output change.

cases.why_hard: The pericope adulterae is a major textual-variant zone with dialogue and a `\wj` span inside the existing local WEB marker evidence.
cases.expected_chunking_risk: Chunking could isolate, split, or red-letter the passage in a way that silently encodes both textual-critical and speaker-attribution decisions.
cases.punctuation_risk: high: dialogue turns and the transition into/out of the passage depend on punctuation and paragraphing.
cases.translation_mismatch_risk: high: editions and translations differ in placement, brackets, inclusion, and red-letter display.
cases.speaker_boundary_risk: high: `\wj` is evidence, not authority; speaker attribution inside a variant zone requires explicit human review.
cases.proposed_gold_needed: Use the existing T316b review packet and add textual-criticism plus speaker review before any gold or output change.
cases.notes: Complements `john7_53_8_11_pericope_adulterae` and the T316b packet by naming the `\wj` plus variant-zone governance issue explicitly.
